description: This file defines functions and configurations for managing VXLAN (Virtual Extensible LAN) tunnels, including setup and teardown procedures for VXLAN and VXLAN6 (IPv6), along with configuration initialization and protocol registration.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup_peer
methods.description: Configures a VXLAN peer device by appending FDB entries based on provided peer configuration.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_setup
methods.description: Sets up a VXLAN or VXLAN6 tunnel with specific parameters and updates the protocol with configuration data.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_setup
methods.description: Initializes VXLAN tunnel configuration with IP and peer address.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_setup
methods.description: Initializes VXLAN6 (IPv6) tunnel configuration with IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: vxlan_generic_init_config
methods.description: Defines default configuration parameters and options for VXLAN.

methods.name: proto_vxlan_init_config
methods.description: Extends the generic VXLAN configuration with IP-specific parameters.

methods.name: proto_vxlan6_init_config
methods.description: Extends the generic VXLAN configuration with IPv6-specific parameters.
